result.brief: 提出可扩展流水线合成可执行的计算机使用智能体环境与长时序任务，并用执行式质量门控保证可解性与验证可靠性，训练出的模型在多个分布外基准上泛化。
result.reason: Synthesizes executable computer-use agent environments and tasks for training; environment synthesis relates to world modeling but is not video/multimodal foundation world model or representation learning.
